entries.047746f5779c0ff3: Joints for water and gas piping, including vinyl-chloride-free joints that use no vinyl chloride at all, are produced by Riken CKJV Co., Ltd. in Takaoka City, Toyama Prefecture. Transparent-coated joints with excellent workability received a Good Design Award. Amounts are not disclosed by category.
entries.219b68e17d6072e6: A business that performs forging and cutting of brass products such as camera mounts, synchro rings and faucet fittings. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,009 million. The production base is the Precision Plant of Sanetsu Kinzoku in Tonami City, Toyama Prefecture.
entries.6143e75a101e24dc: Rods produced at the Tonami, Takaoka and Shin-Nitto plants of Sanetsu Kinzoku, the Sakai plant of NIPPON SHINDO CO., LTD., and the head office plant of Mitani Shindo. Amounts are not disclosed by product category.
entries.70c8cc8e99ca5082: Detachable parts for the body and lens of digital single-lens reflex cameras. Amounts are not disclosed by category.
entries.87d9b6d16cb4625f: The holding company of a group that manufactures and sells copper and brass products such as brass rods and brass wire, as well as pipe fittings and precision parts.
entries.a5604c64f045343b: Wire and pipe products, including plated wire, which are widely used as materials for automobiles, home appliances, faucet fittings and other products. Amounts are not disclosed by product category.
entries.bf7bc1c5c53007f4: The main business produces brass rods, brass wires and brass pipes, which it sells as materials for parts used in housing-related products, home appliances and automobiles. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥131,442 million. The company has commercialized environmentally friendly alloys that do not use environmentally hazardous substances such as lead and cadmium, and holds numerous patents. Production is handled by Sanetsu Kinzoku, [[company:nippon-shindo|NIPPON SHINDO CO., LTD.]], Mitani Shindo and others.
entries.c579d12cf9d50318: The company forges and cuts synchronizer ring components used in automobile manual transmissions, faucet fittings and other products. Amounts are not disclosed by category.
entries.ff66c827bf8fb4e8: A business that produces joints used in water and gas piping and performs hot-dip galvanizing, an anti-corrosion treatment for steel materials. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥11,985 million. Joints are produced by Riken CKJV Co., Ltd., and plating is produced by CK Kinzoku.
